title: I'm making a third person MOBA you play right in your browser
author: AlijaZZ
selftext:
Hey! I made Kaveth, a MOBA you play in third person, over the shoulder. It runs in the browser, it's free

I built it mainly with Claude (Opus 5.5), with some help from Codex. It took a lot of playing, testing and going back and forth to get the movement and fights to feel right.

There are three heroes, one lane with towers and Soldiers, bots, and multiplayer lobbies so you can play with your friends. It also has a classic top-down view, which is a full MOBA camera of its own and honestly one of the coolest parts, so give it a try too.



Play it here: [https://kaveth.pages.dev](https://kaveth.pages.dev)



Would love to hear what you think.
